eligibility_criteria.domicile_ncr_rule: Delhi (NCT) domicile / passed qualifying school exams from Delhi per scheme terms.
eligibility_criteria.income_cap: No rigid cap where guarantee applies (subject to lending bank/DHEAS norms [VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION])
eligibility_criteria.category_rules: Open to all categories meeting qualifying Delhi schooling/admission rules.
eligibility_criteria.academic_or_work_rules: Admission in recognised higher education / skill / diploma course.
eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Students without Delhi qualifying school/domicile eligibility.

benefit.summary_hi: उच्च, तकनीकी व कौशल पाठ्यक्रमों के लिए बिना गारंटी शिक्षा ऋण हेतु सरकारी गारंटी सहायता।
benefit.summary_en: Collateral-free education loan guarantee/facilitation for higher/technical/skill courses [VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION].

benefit_summary.en: Collateral-free education loan guarantee/facilitation for higher/technical/skill courses [VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION].

application_steps.online: Apply on edistrict.delhigovt.nic.in / Delhi Higher Ed portal.
application_steps.offline: Apply through participating bank branch / CFC in Delhi.

verification_note.hi: नोट ([VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION]): वर्तमान 2026–27 सक्रिय आवेदन विंडो, स्लैब व अंतिम नियम कृपया आधिकारिक सरकारी पोर्टल पर सत्यापित करें।
verification_note.en: Notice ([VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION]): Always verify active 2026–27 window, exact slab/amount, and current circular on the official portal before applying.

anti_dalal.csc_fee_note_hi: सरकारी CFC या CSC केंद्र पर केवल निर्धारित सेवा शुल्क (₹0–₹50) व पक्की रसीद लागू
anti_dalal.csc_fee_note_en: Nominal authorized CFC/CSC facilitation fee only (always take printed receipt)
anti_dalal.receipt_rule: Always collect your official Acknowledgement Slip & Reference Number after submission. Never pay without a printed receipt.
anti_dalal.middleman_warning: Never pay agents/middlemen promising guaranteed approval or faster clearance. Benefits are disbursed strictly via DBT / official portals.
